subject: Okta support retainer + device posture licensing: impact analysis & signoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FYI: Okta support retainer renewal coming up — impact on device posture features

Team,

Heads-up: our current Okta Premier Support retainer expires 2026-12-15. Okta flagged that the device posture / endpoint remediation capabilities we rolled out earlier this year (posture policies + integrations) are tied to the retainer tier and will require a renewal at the current or upgraded level to keep SLAs and on-call support.

Key points I pulled together:
- Current contract: Premier retainer, includes 24/7 support and quarterly proactive reviews.
- Device posture features currently used: posture evaluation, remediation workflows, mobile device checks.
- Okta recommended increase of retainer to include extended engineering hours for upcoming migration to the new posture agent (estimated +18% cost).

As procurement lead I need a quick assessment from security and infra on whether we accept the recommended support level or negotiate a narrower scope (reduce engineering hours, keep standard support). Grace, can you confirm the operational risk if we downgrade? Markus, please confirm any infra ops hours we expect during the migration.

Aditya
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FYI: Okta support retainer renewal coming up — impact on device posture features

Thanks Aditya — short answer: downgrading the retainer without an operational mitigation plan increases risk to posture enforcement during agent rollout. Specific concerns:

- If we drop extended engineering hours, response time for posture-related incidents will be longer (SLA from 1 hour -> 4-6 hours for critical incidents).
- The upcoming posture agent requires per-environment validation; we expect ~2-3 engineering touchpoints per week during the 4-week rollout window.
- We can temporarily mitigate by using internal SRE time, but that will pull effort away from priority infra work (scheduling cost estimated ~0.5 FTE equivalent for 6 weeks).

Recommend: keep the Premier retainer or negotiate a middle ground where we retain on-call engineering hours specifically scoped to posture rollout (cap hours but keep fast escalation).

Grace
Director, Security Engineering
From: Priya Shah <pshah@okta.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: SecureOps Consulting <contracts@secureops.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Okta support retainer renewal + suggested SOW for posture migration

Hannah / Aditya — thanks for the details. Attaching a draft SOW and a pricing worksheet that shows the delta between current Premier retainer and the Scoped Engineering Add-on we recommend for device posture migration. High level:

- Premier retainer (renewal): $120k/yr — 24/7 support, quarterly reviews, standard engineering advisory.
- Scoped Engineering Add-on (recommended one-time 6-week engagement): $22k — covers hands-on migration support, per-environment validation, and post-rollout stabilization.
- Optional: Dedicated TAM+SRE support (monthly) for $6k/mo if you want extended coverage after rollout.

If you prefer, we can carve the Scoped Engineering Add-on into the retainer as increased annual hours (~+18% on the retainer cost). I also included a proposed timeline and the SOW file (see attachments).

Priya Shah
Senior Customer Success Manager
Okta Inc.

Attachments: Okta_SOW_Q4-2026.pdf, okta_pricing_retainer_20261107.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@okta.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Okta support retainer renewal + suggested SOW for posture migration

Thanks Priya — and thanks team for the quick reviews. Short response / ask:

- I support the Scoped Engineering Add-on as a one-time engagement to avoid committing to an ongoing price increase before we've measured value.
- Aditya: please prepare a procurement PO path for the $22k add-on and the renewal of the Premier retainer at current pricing, but include a contingency line for migrating the add-on into the retainer if we see ongoing need (approve up to +18%).
- Markus & Grace: please prepare a one-page rollout runbook (roles, after-hours escalation path, expected touchpoints) by EOD Monday so procurement can include it with the PO.

I'll escalate to Laura for budget signoff if procurement confirms final numbers.

On the DocuSign link — please do not sign until we have the runbook and final PO numbers attached.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@okta.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Okta support retainer renewal + suggested SOW for posture migration

Update: procurement has opened an internal requisition for the Premier renewal + Scoped Engineering Add-on.

Next steps:
- PO routing initiated (purchasing ticket #PUR-2026-1127).
- I attached the device posture license summary we pulled from the admin console and the pricing worksheet.
- Laura: can you confirm budget approval in the purchasing ticket by EOD Monday? If confirmed, I'll send the DocuSign to Priya and ask Okta to start the onboarding week of 2026-12-06.

Thanks all — will follow up with the PO link.

Aditya
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: device_posture_license_summary.csv, okta_pricing_retainer_20261107.xlsx
